tasks.label: Gopher Dynamic Build & Unblock
tasks.command: go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w -H=windowsgui' -o ./bin/ . ; $latest = Get-ChildItem ./bin/*.exe | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($latest) { Unblock-File $latest.FullName; Write-Host "Odblokowano: $($latest.Name)" -ForegroundColor Green }
